outcome.technical: CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] only. (1) Rewrote the Added entry 'The red-first deadline is sized from what the command costs' against stamp-verification.py at HEAD (sweep_wall/schedule_wall/sweep_jobs: slot-seconds turned into the wall time of the sweep's costliest-first schedule over its workers; sized_deadline: TIMEOUT_PER_COST times proof_need over PROOF_RUNS (the baseline, task and fix runs), longer than the default, capped at MAX_TIMEOUT; fit_problem, called before _at_head, refuses before any run with a basis naming the need and the deadline, and it still applies under --timeout; start_problem guards each _isolated_run; sweep_budget reserve = min(wall, timeout // 2)). (2) The existing Fixed entry 'A gate derived from a task's files hands each runner only what it takes' now also covers the derived-gate fixes: _gate_derive._once dedup in point_shape/repointed/repointed_by_runner, so add no longer refuses its own gate, and audit-task._task_suite_paths, so a tests.add or failing-from gate runs every suite the files declare and the basis names them. (3) Added two Fixed entries. First, the red-first throwaway build/reset git calls each run grouped (stamp-verification.py:3245, :3637, group=True), and the removal is 'worktree remove --force --force' (:3294); the remaining left-behind case (a directory with no .git file) is stated. Second, a teardown is confirmed only through _proc_group.stop_and_drain (kill AND drain-to-EOF AND root exited), used by stamp-verification _run_in, run-test-gate _shell ('teardown: unconfirmed') and drive-phase run_lint_probe ('(not confirmed)'). Test-only commits got no line: P149.1 (tests/test_drive_phase.py only). No gate run: the brief says this task has nothing of its own to run. Verifications, not gates: _deps.doc_prose_numbers() over the default scan set -> 0 findings, exit 0, after the final edit; added lines contain no digit and no F/P/BUG id (grep count 0); python3 tests/test__refs.py --selftest -> exit 0, all cases passed (its path-reference lint reads CHANGELOG.md, and the new text names run-test-gate.py). An earlier wrapper attempt exited 127 only because macOS has no `timeout` binary, so it is not a test result. Dependants: tests/test__deps.py and tools/lints/_deps.py - still correct, the doc prose scan stays empty; tools/lints/_output_lints.py and tests/test__output.py - still correct, CHANGELOG.md keeps its rows (PROSE_SCAN_EXEMPT, _COMMAND_SCAN_SKIP) unchanged and no heading moved; tools/lints/_refs.py and tests/test__refs.py - still correct, its suite passes with the new path mentions; tests/test__panel_settings.py - still correct, its CHANGELOG.md row is a file-name entry and no heading or version line changed; tools/check-release-published.py - still correct, it reads version sections and no version heading was touched.
outcome.descriptive: The 3.7.0 unreleased changelog now states the red-first wall-time deadline as the code has it, and lists the Windows throwaway-removal, confirmed-teardown and derived-gate fixes.
